scoring_basis: experiments/measure/fresh-diagnostic-v1/rules.json definitions (complete, partial, false_abstention, citation_support, point_attribution) apply unchanged.
point_scoring: Each required point scores 1 (accurately published with an entailing citation), 0.5 (partly published, e.g. one of two values), or 0. Equivalent passages that state the same fact count; document them.
unsupported_claim: A published claim whose cited passages do not entail it (metric, unit, population, configuration, scope). Counted separately from points, also within partial answers.
misleading_claim: A published claim that is technically cited but misattributes scope, category or causation.

arms.A: Baseline/B2 deployed (create_research, quality_check=True, table comparisons off, top_k 8)
arms.B: A + opt-in deterministic question decomposition (question_parts @ retrieval-v3 f6efa05; original + at most 3 parts; round-robin merge; cap 14). Nothing else differs.

fixed: gpt-6.1-sol, effort low, 300 s timeout, ChatGPT login; same pinned B2 index; same frozen questions; synthesis and answer-quality review unchanged. No tuning of decomposition after freezing.

prefer_B_only_if_all: B scores at least 2.0 more required points than A in total (out of 27), as source-reviewed
B wins more questions than it loses on points
B publishes no more unsupported or misleading claims than A
B has no more abstentions (false or evidence-limited) than A
B median total response time per question is at most 15 s above A, and B p90 at most 30 s above A
decision_rule.otherwise: Keep A as the default. A gain of 0.5 to 1.5 points is inconclusive: B stays opt-in, not integrated.
decision_rule.execution_errors: Questions with an execution error in either arm are excluded pairwise and reported; if more than 2 pairs are excluded the comparison is inconclusive.

review: Machine-assisted source review first; final scores require independent human review of answer-key.md and every published claim. Automated anchor screens are reported separately and never replace source review.
